description_ar: إعلان مبيعات: اسم المنتج بتوهج، مميزات كلمة بكلمة، سعر بعدّاد، وزر «اطلب الآن» ينبض.
description_en: Sales ad: glowing product name, features revealed word by word, a counting price and a pulsing call-to-action button.
scene_blueprint_en: Scene 1 - Hook: product name huge with a colored glow, tagline below.
Scene 2 - Benefits: 3 short benefits (word-by-word or staggered slide-right), each with a small icon-like shape.
Scene 3 - Offer: price counter (digits arabic, suffix currency) + pulsing pill CTA with keyframe scale 1 -> 1.07 -> 1.
rules_en: The CTA button is a rounded rect (radius 999) with contrasting fill and dark text.
Show a number (price/discount) with a counter layer.
End on the CTA for the last 1.5 s.
